description: This file defines classes related to process container management within the WPEFramework, including network interface iteration, container control, and container administration.

classes.name: CNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network interfaces associated with a process container.

classes.name: CContainer
classes.description: Represents a process container with control and information retrieval capabilities.

classes.name: CContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple process containers, providing creation, removal, and listing functionalities.

methods.name: CNetworkInterfaceIterator(const ProcessContainer* container)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the network interface iterator for a specific container.

methods.name: ~CNetworkInterfaceIterator()
methods.description: Destructor for the network interface iterator.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the network interface.

methods.name: NumAddresses()
methods.description: Returns the number of IP addresses associated with the interface.

methods.name: IP(uint32_t id)
methods.description: Returns the IP address corresponding to the given index.

methods.name: CContainer(ProcessContainer* container)
methods.description: Constructor for the container class, wrapping a ProcessContainer object.

methods.name: ~CContainer()
methods.description: Destructor for the container class.

methods.name: Id()
methods.description: Returns the container's identifier.

methods.name: Pid()
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: Memory()
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information of the container.

methods.name: Cpu()
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container's network interfaces.

methods.name: IsRunning()
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start(const string& command, IStringIterator& parameters)
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the container object.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the container object.

methods.name: CContainerAdministrator()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the container administrator.

methods.name: ~CContainerAdministrator()
methods.description: Destructor for the container administrator.

methods.name: Container(const string& id, IStringIterator& searchpaths, const string& logpath, const string& configuration)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on the provided ID and search paths.

methods.name: Logging(const string& logDir, const string& loggingOptions)
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.

methods.name: Containers()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all managed containers.

methods.name: RemoveContainer(IContainer*)
methods.description: Removes a container from management.
